build_MLP_for_ViT: build a two-layer MLP module for Vision Transformer with configurable activation and dropout
build_SwiGLU_module: build a SwiGLU gated linear unit module with split fc1 for checkpoint compatibility
create_MLP_with_conv: create an MLP using 1x1 conv layers instead of linear for NCHW tensor input
init_SwiGLU_weights: initialize SwiGLU gate weights near zero with bias set to one
review_Mlp_forward: review the Mlp forward pass that applies fc1, activation, dropout, norm, fc2, and dropout
